entities.name: Silesian University in Opava
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The Silesian University in Opava, is a university offering tertiary education. It was
established by the law, adopted by the Czech National Council on 9 July 1991, making it one of the youngest universities in the Czech Republic.
